name: amfx-btc-eom-bounce-research
description: amFX reproduction (16JUN22 p3): BTC price from Nov 2021 peak to Jun 2022 crash with end-of-month periods highlighted. Bloomberg-style area chart. End-of-month periods (day >= 25) are highlighted as a band to show the recurring bounce pattern before LUNA/Celsius/3AC forced liquidations overwhelmed normal flows in May-Jun 2022.
source:
# =============================================================================
# AMFX REPRODUCTION: BTC WITH END-OF-MONTH BOUNCES (16JUN22 p3)
# =============================================================================
# BTC from $69K peak (Nov 2021) to $21K crash (Jun 2022).
# End-of-month periods highlighted -- circles in original show how BTC
# consistently bounced in the last week of each month (new allocations)
# until LUNA/Celsius/3AC broke the pattern in May-Jun 2022.
#
# Band series marks day-of-month >= 25 as end-of-month window.
# =============================================================================

btc = crypto_pairs(ticker='BTCUSD')()
close = btc.c
idx = index()

# Day of month
dom = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.day)(idx)

# End-of-month flag: 1 when day >= 25, 0 otherwise
eom_flag = dom >= 25
eom_band = eom_flag * 1.0

xy_lines(
    title='BTC: Did End-of-Month Bounces Persist Through the Crash?',
    category='BTC EOM Bounce',
    y_axis_label='BTC Price (USD)',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.MonetaryFormat,
    y_axis_dp=0,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='BTC/USD', color=Color.Blue, area=True),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='End-of-Month Window (day >= 25)', color=Color.Sky, is_band=True)
    ]),
    order=0
)(idx, close, eom_band)
